sloka: तां धर्षणामदूरस्थां दृष्ट्वा चात्मनि पार्थिव: ।चिन्तार्णवगत: पारं नाससादाप्लवो यथा ॥ २.११८.३६॥
transliteration: tāṁ dharṣaṇāmadūrasthāṁ dṛṣṭvā cātmani pārthiva: ।cintārṇavagata: pāraṁ nāsasādāplavo yathā ॥ 2.118.36॥

translations.english: Having perceived that the humiliation is not very far, king Janaka was plunged in a sea of sorrow like one who cannot reach the shore without a float.
